content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aircraft parts, MRO and military shelters differ from Viasat's satellite connectivity and communications business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Telecom billing and operations software and IT services, not satellite connectivity or defense communications."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Rural wireless and fixed-line carrier services, lacking satellite networks, aviation or maritime connectivity."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Industrial IoT cellular routers and modules, not satellite broadband or in-flight or maritime connectivity services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Utility meters, filtration and test equipment, with defense electronics only one separate segment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Network security hardware and cybersecurity subscriptions, not satellite connectivity or communications systems."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Alaska terrestrial wireless, cable and fiber telecom carrier, without satellite or aviation or maritime connectivity."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"In-flight satellite and air-to-ground connectivity sold to airlines and aircraft operators, matching Viasat's aviation connectivity business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise data storage hardware and data management software, unrelated to satellite communications."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Engineering and cybersecurity services under government contracts, not satellite hardware or connectivity services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"US wireless and wireline consumer and small-business carrier, lacking satellite and aviation or maritime connectivity."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers, a terrestrial infrastructure model without satellite services."}]}
